title: The unexpected charge
opening: Hi, I'm looking at my statement and there is a charge for eighty-nine dollars that I definitely did not make. I need to know what happened here.
customerReply: No, I still have my card with me. I only noticed the charge this morning, but I used the card at a café yesterday afternoon.
responses: Do you still have the card, and when did you first notice the charge?
Would you like me to read your recent transactions out loud?
Are you sure someone in your household did not use the card?
actionHint: Secure the card and begin the unauthorized transaction process.
